title: Continue
shortDescription: The server has received the request headers and the client should proceed to send the request body.

title: Switching Protocols
shortDescription: The requester has asked the server to switch protocols and the server has agreed to do so.

title: Processing
shortDescription: The server has received and is processing the request, but no response is available yet.

title: Early Hints
shortDescription: Used to return some response headers before final HTTP message.

title: OK
shortDescription: The request succeeded.

title: Created
shortDescription: The request succeeded and a new resource was created.

title: Accepted
shortDescription: The request has been accepted for processing, but processing has not been completed.

title: Non-Authoritative Information
shortDescription: The returned meta-information is not exactly the same as is available from the origin server.

title: No Content
shortDescription: The request succeeded but returns no content.

title: Reset Content
shortDescription: Tells the user agent to reset the document which sent this request.

title: Partial Content
shortDescription: The server is delivering only part of the resource due to a range header sent by the client.

title: Multi-Status
shortDescription: Conveys information about multiple resources in situations where multiple status codes might be appropriate.

title: Already Reported
shortDescription: The members of a DAV binding have already been enumerated in a preceding part of the response.

title: IM Used
shortDescription: The server has fulfilled a request for the resource, and the response is a representation of the result of one or more instance-manipulations.

title: Multiple Choices
shortDescription: The request has more than one possible response and the user agent should choose one.

title: Moved Permanently
shortDescription: The URL of the requested resource has been changed permanently.

title: Found
shortDescription: The URI of the requested resource has been changed temporarily.

title: See Other
shortDescription: The server sends this response to direct the client to get the requested resource at another URI with a GET request.

title: Not Modified
shortDescription: Indicates that the resource has not been modified since the version specified by the request headers.

title: Use Proxy
shortDescription: The requested resource is available only through a proxy, whose address is provided in the response.

title: Temporary Redirect
shortDescription: The server sends this response to direct the client to get the requested resource at another URI with the same method.

title: Permanent Redirect
shortDescription: The resource is now permanently located at another URI, specified by the Location header.

title: Bad Request
shortDescription: The server cannot process the request due to a client error.

title: Unauthorized
shortDescription: Authentication is required and has failed or has not yet been provided.

title: Payment Required
shortDescription: Reserved for future use. Originally intended for digital payment systems.

title: Forbidden
shortDescription: The client does not have access rights to the content.

title: Not Found
shortDescription: The server can not find the requested resource.

title: Method Not Allowed
shortDescription: The request method is known by the server but is not supported by the target resource.

title: Not Acceptable
shortDescription: The server cannot produce a response matching the list of acceptable values defined in the request's content negotiation headers.

title: Proxy Authentication Required
shortDescription: The client must first authenticate itself with the proxy.

title: Request Timeout
shortDescription: The server would like to shut down this unused connection.

title: Conflict
shortDescription: The request conflicts with the current state of the server.

title: Gone
shortDescription: The requested resource is no longer available and will not be available again.

title: Length Required
shortDescription: The server refuses to accept the request without a defined Content-Length header.

title: Precondition Failed
shortDescription: The server does not meet one of the preconditions that the requester put on the request.

title: Payload Too Large
shortDescription: The request is larger than the server is willing or able to process.

title: URI Too Long
shortDescription: The URI provided was too long for the server to process.

title: Unsupported Media Type
shortDescription: The media format of the requested data is not supported by the server.

title: Range Not Satisfiable
shortDescription: The range specified by the Range header in the request cannot be fulfilled.

title: Expectation Failed
shortDescription: The expectation given in the request's Expect header could not be met by the server.

title: I'm a teapot
shortDescription: The server refuses the attempt to brew coffee with a teapot.

title: Misdirected Request
shortDescription: The request was directed at a server that is not able to produce a response.

title: Unprocessable Entity
shortDescription: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

title: Locked
shortDescription: The resource that is being accessed is locked.

title: Failed Dependency
shortDescription: The request failed because it depended on another request and that request failed.

title: Too Early
shortDescription: Indicates that the server is unwilling to risk processing a request that might be replayed.

title: Upgrade Required
shortDescription: The server refuses to perform the request using the current protocol but might be willing to do so after the client upgrades.

title: Precondition Required
shortDescription: The origin server requires the request to be conditional.

title: Too Many Requests
shortDescription: The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time.

title: Request Header Fields Too Large
shortDescription: The server is unwilling to process the request because its header fields are too large.

title: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
shortDescription: The user agent requested a resource that cannot be legally provided.

title: Internal Server Error
shortDescription: The server encountered an unexpected condition that prevented it from fulfilling the request.

title: Not Implemented
shortDescription: The server does not support the functionality required to fulfill the request.

title: Bad Gateway
shortDescription: The server, while acting as a gateway or proxy, received an invalid response from the upstream server.

title: Service Unavailable
shortDescription: The server is currently unable to handle the request due to a temporary overload or scheduled maintenance.

title: Gateway Timeout
shortDescription: The server, while acting as a gateway or proxy, did not receive a timely response from the upstream server.

title: HTTP Version Not Supported
shortDescription: The server does not support the HTTP protocol version used in the request.

title: Variant Also Negotiates
shortDescription: The server has an internal configuration error: the chosen variant is itself configured to engage in content negotiation.

title: Insufficient Storage
shortDescription: The server is unable to store the representation needed to complete the request.

title: Loop Detected
shortDescription: The server detected an infinite loop while processing the request.

title: Not Extended
shortDescription: Further extensions to the request are required for the server to fulfill it.

title: Network Authentication Required
shortDescription: The client needs to authenticate to gain network access.
